Label: IS-1 interneuron of hippocampal CA1
Definition: A GABAergic interneuron of the hippocampal CA1 area and a subtype of interneuron-specific (IS) interneuron that expresses calretinin but not vasoactive intestinal polypeptide (VIP). IS-1 cells were originally identified in rat hippocampus by immunocytochemistry and electron microscopy as a calretinin-positive subset of IS interneurons that form synaptic contacts exclusively onto other GABAergic interneurons (Gulyas et al. 1996; Acsady et al. 1996, as cited in 1, 2). Somata of IS-1 cells are located in the CA1 stratum oriens (1). Their postsynaptic targets include other calretinin-positive interneurons, schaffer collateral-associated (SCA) interneurons, and perforant path-associated (PPA) interneurons (2). IS-1 cells function as disinhibitory circuit elements by selectively inhibiting other GABAergic interneurons rather than principal cells (1, 2).
Comment: IS-1 is VIP-negative (does not express vasoactive intestinal polypeptide; VIP expression column left empty). IS-1 is not covered by CL:4023016 (VIP GABAergic interneuron), which requires VIP expression; parent 2 is therefore CL:0011005 (GABAergic interneuron). Specific synaptic targets from Tzilivaki et al. 2023 Table 1: calretinin-positive cells including other IS cells, SCA interneurons, PPA interneurons. The soma location in stratum oriens follows the classical description (Gulyas et al. 1996, cited in PMID:23162426 and PMID:37467748); direct experimental confirmation in the reviewed primary literature is stronger for IS-3 (Tyan et al. 2014, PMID:24671999) than for IS-1. Evidence base is from rodents (rat: Gulyas/Acsady 1996; mouse: Tzilivaki et al. 2023). CL:IS_UMBRELLA is a placeholder for the umbrella IS interneuron term (interneuron-specific interneuron of hippocampal CA1), which has no assigned CL ID at time of authoring.

Label: IS-2 interneuron of hippocampal CA1
Definition: A GABAergic interneuron of the hippocampal CA1 area and a subtype of interneuron-specific (IS) interneuron that expresses vasoactive intestinal polypeptide (VIP) but not calretinin. IS-2 cells were identified in rat hippocampus as a VIP-positive, calretinin-negative subset of IS interneurons that form synaptic contacts exclusively onto other GABAergic interneurons (Gulyas et al. 1996; Acsady et al. 1996, as cited in 1, 2). Their postsynaptic targets include schaffer collateral-associated (SCA) interneurons, perforant path-associated (PPA) interneurons, other IS-2 cells, and CCK/VIP basket cells (2). IS-2 cells function as disinhibitory circuit elements by selectively inhibiting other GABAergic interneurons rather than principal cells (1, 2).
Comment: IS-2 is calretinin-negative (does not express calretinin/Calb2; calretinin expression column left empty). Soma location in CA1 stratum oriens (UBERON:0014552) is LOW CONFIDENCE: not directly confirmed in the primary experimental studies reviewed; assigned by classical analogy with the IS-1 soma location description (Tzilivaki et al. 2023). Specific synaptic targets from Tzilivaki et al. 2023 Table 1: SCA, PPA, IS-2, CCK/VIP basket cells. Evidence base is from rodents (rat: Gulyas/Acsady 1996). CL:IS_UMBRELLA is a placeholder for the umbrella IS interneuron term (interneuron-specific interneuron of hippocampal CA1), which has no assigned CL ID at time of authoring.

Label: IS-3 interneuron of hippocampal CA1
Definition: A GABAergic interneuron of the hippocampal CA1 area and a subtype of interneuron-specific (IS) interneuron that co-expresses vasoactive intestinal polypeptide (VIP) and calretinin. IS-3 cells were characterised in mouse hippocampus by dual simultaneous patch-clamp recordings and targeted optogenetic stimulation in VIP-eGFP and CR-Cre transgenic mice, which directly demonstrated their VIP and calretinin co-expression and confirmed that their somata are located in stratum pyramidale and stratum radiatum of CA1 (1). IS-3 cells form synaptic contacts exclusively onto other GABAergic interneurons, preferentially targeting oriens-lacunosum moleculare (OLM) cells, bistratified cells (BiC), CCK/VIP basket cells, and oriens-oriens interneurons (1, 2). Convergent activation of multiple IS-3 cells regulates OLM interneuron firing rate and timing, establishing a disinhibitory circuit role for these cells in the hippocampal feedback inhibitory circuit (1).
Comment: Soma location in stratum pyramidale (UBERON:0014548) and stratum radiatum (UBERON:0014554) directly confirmed by Tyan et al. 2014 (PMID:24671999): "The somas of these cells are located in the stratum pyramidale (PYR) or radiatum (RAD)". Specific synaptic targets confirmed by dual patch-clamp recordings in Tyan et al. 2014: OLM cells, bistratified cells (BiC), CCK/VIP basket cells, oriens-oriens interneurons. This is the best-characterised of the three IS subtypes with direct in vitro functional evidence. IS-3 is VIP+ and calretinin+, making it the only IS subtype co-expressing both markers. Evidence base from rodents (mouse: Tyan et al. 2014, PMID:24671999; rat: Acsady/Gulyas 1996 as cited in PMID:37467748). CL:IS_UMBRELLA is a placeholder for the umbrella IS interneuron term (interneuron-specific interneuron of hippocampal CA1), which has no assigned CL ID at time of authoring.
